attempt: system Python

attempt: require every preserved page to be wholly contained in N=1
detail: A valid preserved page bracketed the Jan-1 boundary. Validator was corrected to prove contiguous pagination first and clip only after parsing to the half-open window.

attempt: representation-sensitive Decimal text and all-three-role mark requirement
detail: Reported 85 Spot representation conflicts, 7200 July monthly mark omissions, and 531 funding schedule errors. Exact Decimal numeric normalization, two-independent-official-representation reconciliation, and preserved exchange funding timestamps removed only validator artifacts.

attempt: aggTrades-only event proof for 2021-04-25T04:00:00Z
detail: Acquired the free official daily raw trades archive and accepted the derived bar only after raw trades and aggTrades matched exactly with complete trade-ID continuity.

attempt: validate every observation in the prior acquisition index before selecting referenced objects
detail: The prior index contains unrelated api.binance.com observations. The inventory was corrected to select analysis-bound prior hashes first, so only authorized Phase-A source objects enter this epoch's evidence.

attempt: accept complete aggTrades continuity without separately binding raw-trades archives on every no-trade day
detail: The initial scan had raw-trade cross-checks for two of four no-trade days. Official free daily raw-trades archives and CHECKSUM objects were then acquired for 2021-03-06 and 2021-04-20; every no-trade range was revalidated across both event roles.

attempt: invoke acquisition utility without its required acquire subcommand
detail: The utility exited with argparse status 2 before acquisition. It was rerun with the explicit acquire subcommand.

attempt: targeted unittest without repository PYTHONPATH
detail: The initial targeted command could not import crypto_lab; it was rerun through the locked project environment and repository import path.

attempt: bulk CSV import with unescaped null representation
detail: DuckDB rejected the first staging representation before canonical commit; the failed database remained non-canonical and the importer was corrected without changing source values.

attempt: derive SourceRegistry paths outside the Phase-A manifest
detail: The builder required manifest-bound content-addressed paths; registry construction was restricted to the attested Phase-A raw-object inventory.

attempt: reuse prior perpetual metadata source role
detail: The prior object did not carry the current official Phase-A role; the build was rebound to the official current exchangeInfo response hash.

attempt: read a non-existent adoption timestamp key
detail: The first build launcher expected the wrong adoption evidence key and stopped before a release was accepted; it was corrected to the attested key.

attempt: primary-v1 full event hashing in row insertion loop
detail: The slow non-canonical attempt was stopped; bulk deterministic staging was implemented while retaining exact Decimal text and raw bindings.

attempt: independent-v1 materialize into immutable primary artifact paths
detail: The independent build correctly refused overwrite; independent artifacts were isolated and final materialization occurred only after comparison.

attempt: v2 release with prior api.binance.com observations
detail: Raw revalidation found 309 prior observations outside this epoch's exact official host allowlist; v2 artifacts were retained locally and excluded from canonical release.

attempt: v2 raw-object allowlist validation
detail: The validator returned FAIL on the prior api.binance.com host, proving the source gate; the final inventory contains only the explicitly authorized official hosts.

attempt: primary-v3 unfiltered publisher checksum insertion
detail: Checksums for objects outside the selected inventory violated source binding; the transaction rolled back and v4 filters checksum bindings to the selected raw inventory.

attempt: full acceptance outside locked UTC runtime
detail: Timezone-sensitive runtime preflight failed before acceptance; the complete suite was rerun under the locked UTC environment and passed.

attempt: physical DuckDB byte equality as deterministic criterion
detail: Fresh databases had different physical hashes as permitted; schema, ordered rows, table hashes, release identities and catalogs were exactly equal.

attempt: treat compileall __pycache__ files as UTF-8 evidence
detail: The finalizer rejected generated bytecode as text evidence; the inventory was narrowed to durable evidence and source artifacts while generated __pycache__ remains ignored.

attempt: read acceptance discovery from the obsolete tests key
detail: The finalizer stopped on KeyError; it was corrected to the validator's attested test_ids field without changing any test result.

attempt: bind negative controls to guessed test class names
detail: Discovery rejected eight non-existent IDs; every binding was replaced by its exact independently discovered test ID.

attempt: compare an already replaced final report to its Phase-A backup
detail: The idempotent rerun stopped because the live report had already advanced; the preserved copy was instead verified against the original Phase-A content manifest hash.
